body:
Founder real-time (remote control, continued): port BIG_O tech into SHANKPIT. Landed phase 3: packages/simulation/npc_archetype.{h,c} (citizen/The Men archetype-differentiated vigilance, thin layer over SHANKPIT's own already-native humanness.c) + zombie_values.{h,c} (zombie hunger/aggression/decay vocabulary, deliberately separate from human mood enum). Per 'use parena duh': the two pure scalar decision formulas (effective vigilance, effective alertness) moved to new PARENA/stdlib/shankpit/ai_brain_rules.prn; everything stateful/time-driven stayed host C, matching humanness_tick_mood's own precedent. Found and fixed a real naming collision (zombie_effective_alertness wanted by both the PARENA export and the host wrapper) along the way. Verified against BIG_O's own real test assertions (npc_archetype_test.c, zombie_values_test.c) to confirm the PARENA move didn't change behavior -- all pass. Not yet wired into the live build (no consumer -- phase 7). SHANKPIT 03ad5e3, PARENA 7c34d18.

⚓ ☃
title: BIG_O engine merge phase 3: humanness AI-brain extensions
